ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:18 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base (RGB < 10,10,10) across >90% of surface area, with high-intensity white pixel disruptions (RGB > 240,240,240) appearing as discrete linear paths and circular clusters distributed heterogeneously across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated 72-degree V-shaped central depression with a pixel-depth of approximately 14% relative to the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing boundary; right lobe exhibits irregular sawtooth peaks (5-12 pixel amplitude) while the left lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the peduncle, transitioning to a sharp upward concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 distinct ring-shaped and circular high-contrast pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter), primarily localized on the distal third of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense mapping of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions; includes a prominent set of four parallel vertical rake marks on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity, high-texture anomalies localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant structural alteration; multiple overlapping linear scars across the central ventral region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a unique, high-contrast 'O' shaped scar located in the upper-central quadrant of the right lobe lobe.
